actions.action: Slide plant out of pot and check roots
If roots rotten, trim rotten parts and repot in fresh chunky aroid mix in a pot with drainage
Remove every spotted leaf with sterilized scissors and bag them for disposal
Spray copper fungicide on tops and undersides of leaves every 7-10 days for 2-3 applications
Water only the soil after the top inch dries out
If new spots keep appearing after two treatments, check leaf undersides for pests with a magnifying glass

reason: The answer names fungal leaf spot as the main diagnosis and recommends removing affected leaves plus a copper fungicide (Bonide), matching the fix that worked; its root check and watering advice are safeguarded and not harmful.
